# dsh-opencode-session-fallback

A small DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that gives
**session-less LLM requests** on OpenCode routes a

fallback `sessionId`, so `auto` permission presets stop
failing every tool call with `400 MissingSes

`sessionId`, so `auto` permission presets stop
failing every tool call with `400 MissingSessionID`.
No global `fetch` patching, no provider config changes, no official package overrides.
## The problem
OpenCode / OpenCode Go reject inference requests that do not carry an `x-opencode-session` header:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
DSH's `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` adapter only lets pi-ai add that header when the request carries

a
`sessionId`. Main conversation calls do carry one — but
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review
` builds its **reviewer request by hand without a `sessionId`**.
So with the `auto` permission preset on an `opencode-go` route:

1. every tool call is first sent to the reviewer model,
2. that request has no session header → gate

way 400,
3. the review fails → DSH fails closed → the tool body never runs:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## The fix

Wrap `ctx.llm.stream` once at startup. Requests that already carry a `sessionId`, or that target a
p
rovider outside the configured list, pass through untouched. Only **session-less requests on OpenCod

e
routes** (in practice: the auto-review reviewer call) get the configured fallback id; pi-ai then a

dds
`x-opencode-session` on its own.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Why not patch `globalThis.fetch` (what some other plugins do)? Because replacing the global `fetch`

wraps
**every** outbound call of the host — including the app's own networking — and can take the wh

ole UI down
with connection errors. This plugin only touches the LLM service method.
## Behavior guarantees
- Existing `sessionId`s are **never** replaced → per-conversation routing / prompt-cache affinity is

preserved.
- Other providers (for example the official `deepseek` provider) are **not affected at a

ll**.
- Options objects passed by callers are **never mutated** (a copy is used, so frozen options a

re fine).
- Uninstalling restores the original `ctx.llm.stream` automatically.
- If the service shap

e changes in a future DSH release, the plugin logs a warning and stays inert instead of
breaking the

ges in a future DSH release, the plugin logs a warning and stays inert instead of
breaking the boot.

## Compatibility
- Built and verified against DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` (desktop) with `opencode-go` + `deepseek-v4.1-flash`,
where it fixed the failure end-to-end (auto preset, tools execute, reviewer returns normal allow/den

y
decisions).
- Requires `ctx.llm.stream` to exist (`inject: ['llm']`); otherwise the plugin logs a

warning and does nothing.
- Pairs well with any DSH version that ships the pi-ai OpenCode providers.

# 中文说明
## 解决的问题

OpenCode / OpenCode Go 要求每个推理请求都带 `x-opencode-session` 头，缺失会返回
`400 MissingSessionID`。DSH 的 `dsh-llm

-pi-ai` 只在请求带 `sessionId` 时才让 pi-ai 补这个头，而
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review` 的 reviewer 请求
是手工拼的、**没有 sessionId**。

结果：在 `opencode-go` 路由 + `auto` 权限预设下，每次工具调用先过 reviewer → reviewer 请求 400 →
审查失败 → fail-closed → 工具全部

`opencode-go` 路由 + `auto` 权限预设下，每次工具调用先过 reviewer → reviewer 请求 400 →
审查失败 → fail-closed → 工具全部无法执行。
## 修复方式
启动时包一层 `ctx.llm.stream`：

- 已有 `sessionId` 的请求（主对话、子代理、压缩、会话标题）**原样透传**；
- 其他 provider（例如官方 `deepseek`）**完全不受影响**；
- 只有「缺 sess

ionId 且命中 OpenCode 路由」的请求（实际就是 reviewer）补一个兜底 id，
pi-ai 随后自动加上 `x-opencode-session`。

**不接管全局 `fetch`**（那会把宿主自身的出网调用一起包住，可能直接让 UI 报 connection error），
也不修改 provider 配置、不覆盖任何官方包。
## 安装
插件在 DSH 启动时装配，**装完必须重启 DSH**。

- npm：`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-opencode-session-fallback`
- GUI：设置 → 插件 → 安装，填包名
- Git：`dsh

plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/zlxlsy666/dsh-opencode-session-fallback.git`
- 本地目录
：`dsh plugin --profile web add "file:C:\path\to\dsh-opencode-session-fallback"`
桌面版的 `desktop` profile 由应用自己管理，请在应用的插件管理器里安装。
启动日志应出现：
[代码示例省略，未执行]

[代码示例省略，未执行]
## 卸载

从插件管理器卸载（或 `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-opencode-session-fallback`）后重启 DSH，
`ctx.llm.stream`

载（或 `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-opencode-session-fallback`）后重启 DSH，
`ctx.llm.stream` 会自动恢复。
## 已验证环境

DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` 桌面版 + `opencode-go` 路由 + `deepseek-v4.1-flash`：修复后 auto 预设下工具正常执行，
reviewer 能正常返回 a

.2` 桌面版 + `opencode-go` 路由 + `deepseek-v4.1-flash`：修复后 auto 预设下工具正常执行，
reviewer 能正常返回 allow/deny 决策。
